description: Enhanced protocol-level error reporting: assorted malformed payloads (truncated array, bare token, whitespace-only) yielding parse errors, lenient tolerance of trailing content after a valid object, method-name case sensitivity, and an unknown method reached via a named-parameter object.

cases.description: truncated JSON array is a parse error
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

cases.description: trailing content after a valid object is tolerated by the lenient parser and the leading request succeeds
bare unquoted token is a parse error
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

cases.description: whitespace-only payload is a parse error
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

cases.description: method name is case-sensitive: Echo is unknown
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found

cases.description: unknown method via named-parameter object is method-not-found
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found
